answer: Charge every new identity an entry fee that is burned, and let the fee spiral upward with each identity funded from the same wallet vertex. It works in four steps: the applicant pays the fee; the network links the wallet as one vertex in the funding graph; the fee for the next identity from that vertex doubles; the burn is verified on-ledger before any transaction. An honest agent pays once, a small ember of cost. A swarm operator pays 10 tokens for the first fake, 20 for the second, 40 for the third, so 20 fakes cost over 10 million tokens, while verification costs one balance check.
